given: the stock table holds a known mix of conforming and non-conforming inventory_codes before the migration
when: the up migration completes its backfill and emits its integrity probe
then: the probe reports a count of non-conforming rows (those left with NULL batch_number/serial_number) that equals the actual number of such rows, surfaced to the migration log before the change is accepted
architectural_notes: Infra observability contract realized by NFR-F6-6-integrity-probe-visibility: a COUNT of NULL batch/serial rows emitted to the migration log by the migration/operational tooling, never domain logic. It gives the operator the blast radius to review against the acceptable-threshold open question. Verified by an R4/NFR-F6-4 real-branch test seeding a known conforming/non-conforming mix and asserting the probe count equals the actual NULL count.

independence.rationale: AC1-AC3 assert the backfilled values and row survival; AC4 asserts the observability probe. The reported count can be wrong or absent while the backfill and survival are correct, and the backfill can be wrong while the count still reports (an incorrect but reported number), so each can break independently
